## APMG Sales Handoff Notification

POST /webhook/sales-handoff-notify

Fires when an admin presses **Send to Sales** on Hot Leads
(app/api/sales/handoff/route.ts -> lib/sales/handoffNotify.ts).

Body: { type: "sales_handoff", version, notifyTo, handedOverAt,
handedOverBy: { email, role, actingAs }, consoleUrl, totalLeads,
leads: [ { leadId, business, contactName, email, phone, website,
sector, campaign, score, band, summary, talkingPoints[],
activity{...}|null, timeline[{ ts, label }] } ] }

ONE email per hand-off, not one per lead: `notifyTo` may be a
comma-separated list and the Gmail node puts every recipient on a
single To: header, so a list costs one Gmail send. The recipient list
is the SAME setting the enquiry notifier uses - Integrations tab ->
Enquiry Notification Emails (app_settings.enquiry_notify_email).

Only NEWLY handed-over leads are sent, so a double-click can't email
the desk twice. Up to 20 leads are briefed in full; the rest are
counted in a "+N more" line.

SETUP
1. Import this workflow, open the Gmail node, confirm the credential.
2. Copy the production webhook URL from the Webhook node.
3. Paste it into the console: Integrations -> Sales Hand-off
   Notification -> Add webhook. (Or set the env var
   N8N_SALES_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL.)
4. Make sure at least one address is set under Enquiry Notification
   Emails - with none set, the app skips the send.
5. Activate the workflow.

AUTH: the app sends the `x-apmg-secret` header when N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET
is set in its environment. Add a matching Header Auth credential on
the Webhook node to close this endpoint to anonymous callers - it is
open until you do. The Format node also refuses any payload whose
`type` is not "sales_handoff".
